conditions.name: raw_or_near_raw_primary_law_evidence
conditions.eligibility_rule: not_applicable when the frozen Phase 5 context lacks retained action-level original or working-translation text; source URLs and locators must not be substituted for the evidence text.

conditions.name: geosave_constrained_structured_support
conditions.disclosure_rationale: This condition intentionally supplies deterministic candidate-action physical consequence summaries and explicit legal uncertainty from frozen Phase 4 and Phase 5 artifacts.

execution_settings.non_retryable_reason: An undesirable selected action is not retryable.
execution_settings.action_order_policy: SHA-256-seeded deterministic permutation of A0,A1,A2,A3,A4,A6 using run_id
execution_settings.provider_sampling_parameter_policy: No provider-specific sampling value is sent until pilot capability validation; repeat rows remain required because hosted inference can vary.

cost_assumptions.image: one 512x512 PNG per request; the input-token planning allowance includes the image, but final billing must use provider-reported usage.
cost_assumptions.retry_cost_policy: Worst case permits one additional full request per eligible row.

pilot_stratification.purpose: Multiple scenarios, conditions, and jurisdictions; one request per candidate model/context before a full benchmark.
